acceptanceCriteria: An explicitly experimental standalone companion binds canonical CEM 0.2 and every canonical native task acceptance criterion to reviewed oracle, Go tests and immutable source snapshots without modifying frozen wire or default Tasks behavior.

Fixed trusted-local Go execution with exact approval retains repair, preservation and new-behavior results and all controls; invalid/unsupported/circular/stale/incomplete comparisons do not become behavioral support. Timeout and interruption retire ordinary descendants.

Historical verification rederives permitted classifications and bindings without running test commands; an opt-in native COMMAND gate uses coherent audited live Tasks reads, rejects stale acceptance/generation/policy/config/candidate, and retains the exact packet/artifact digests in gate output.

Actual compiled CLI usage and disposable nonfixture native Tasks init/qualification/cutover/claim/submit/gate/integration/complete/readback/audit are retained alongside adversarial tests and independent intent review.

The proposed spec, requirement traceability, preregistered three-arm outcome protocol, rollout/rollback and NOT_RUN external outcome evidence are retained; focused tests/vet/docs checks and Corvint CEM/dogfood binding are completed before ready PR publication. Production landing and native completion remain required, so PR publication alone does not close this ticket.
body:
Owner authorized implementation on 2026-09-30: "ok, work on it", following the CEM 0.4 experimental-adapter proposal; usage credits explicitly authorized. Implements the bounded feasibility slice of parent V1-0573, whose original outcome/evaluation criteria remain unchanged and open. Gate A independent Astra/medium review passed with no HIGH; coherent native snapshot reads, historical-vs-live distinction, retained gate packet digests, fixed Go profile and exact native gate phases adopted. Plan retained at /private/tmp/cem04-build/plan.txt; base origin/main 9afd8313edad658d6c40b1abe454fe7417eb6cad; isolated branch codex/cem04-experiments. Existing CEM frozen wires and default Tasks policy/schema stay unchanged. Proposed experimental spec CEX-V0; Core/Tasks promotion and external superiority are not granted. No merge/release/forcepush authority. Ready PR publication is authorized by standing owner instruction.

Implementation handoff, 2026-10-01: PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/416 is ready for review at sealed commit 554aab8193dabb24763df4b525bee18da7f4a48c (tree 5bb89dc3b6e2c0502a2cf07b9542ab8f93556ba5). Source commit: 964224af637fee3b4d2b865fcc34c74914528a06. CEM binding: bf30b1391c64b24e592e307fd61d996ad966ad2b.

Focused tests and vet, the frozen CEM corpus, docs and traceability checks, strict local completion, current/base verification and the rename-only seal passed. The actual compiled nonfixture native Tasks lifecycle retained eight scenarios and three eligible controls, all killed. One independent reviewer passed after two bounded repair cycles. The native focused-docs gate passed on the exact sealed tree with scope WITHIN; retained gate result: 805af21cbf8b0fa99684e2244ae4145e7f8a27d6c5b1cdb14225f83ec5f88786. Attempt 83 was released for adjudication after publication.

Production integration and native completion remain open. At handoff, hosted doc-gates, containment, docs-plan and Go interop passed; artifact integrity and four product shards were still running. This chat does not authorize merge or release. Continue integration of the existing PR when authorized, then obtain the current native attempt, gate and completion evidence; preserve the delivered implementation.

Experimental defects found before promotion were repaired: the classifier admitted marker substrings in wrong assertions, filenames or nested source references; contradictory error/pass observations were accepted; and executable file modes were staged incorrectly. Expected behavior is invalid-control or refusal for those false-positive observations and exact staged permissions. Reproductions, failed runs and the two independent repair cycles are retained. Native integration friction around NONE write barriers, canonical nested-record LF and raw versus WQO policy identities was resolved. Native OUT_OF_SCOPE caught missing trailing slashes in directory declarations; widening corrected them before successful submission.

The broader FPK OCM keeps 52 obligations unassessed and structural testExecution NOT_RUN; actual test observations are separate. The CEX technical profile remains proposed, and external comparative outcomes are NOT_RUN. Parent V1-0573's criteria are unchanged. Evidence/checkpoint: /private/tmp/cem04-build. Preserved source worktree: /private/tmp/corvint-cem04-experiments. Unrelated primary work is preserved.

Tool checks used Core 1.0.0-rc.1/build163 and Tasks build202. Official channel checks found v1.0.0-rc.1 and tasks-dev-20260929.2; publisher/runtime qualification limits are retained. No global installation or downgrade occurred. The owner explicitly authorized usage credits; no reset credits were redeemed.
